headline: National Fertilizers announces senior management retirement
hook: Leadership change at state-run fertilizer firm
summary: National Fertilizers Limited has announced a retirement within its senior management team. No specific financial impact or replacement timeline was disclosed in the filing. The company operates in the government-controlled agri-inputs sector. Indian retail investors holding the stock should note routine executive transitions as standard corporate updates.
why_it_matters: Routine management retirement with no immediate impact on stock value.
